WITH lab_patient AS (
  SELECT L.ID, L.ALB, L.UN, L.`T-BIL`, P.SEX
  FROM Laboratory L
  INNER JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
),
group_level AS (
  SELECT 
    ID, 
    SEX,
    AVG(ALB) as avg_alb,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN UN IS NOT NULL AND `T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND `T-BIL` != 0 
      THEN CAST(UN AS REAL) / `T-BIL` 
      ELSE NULL 
    END) as avg_ratio
  FROM lab_patient
  GROUP BY ID, SEX
),
sex_level AS (
  SELECT 
    SEX,
    AVG(avg_alb) as A,
    AVG(avg_ratio) as sex_level_avg_ratio
  FROM group_level
  GROUP BY SEX
),
b_level AS (
  SELECT AVG(A) as B
  FROM sex_level
)
SELECT 
  s.SEX,
  s.A,
  s.sex_level_avg_ratio,
  s.A - b.B as a_minus_b
FROM sex_level s
CROSS JOIN b_level b
WHERE b.B IS NOT NULL AND s.A > b.B
ORDER BY s.SEX
